heard: Seventy souls went down to the Nile, Gad's sons walked in a single file, Zithian, Haggai, and Shuni too, Esbaneri, Arodi, Aureli's view. Jacob's household, sixty-six count, two sons born in the new ground, Seventy total, safe and sound, in the land where the wheat is found. Wilderness years, the census calls Clans of Gad standing in the halls From Zephon to the Zephonite name Shunni's line, none lost from fame Shunite clan, east of the Jordan stream Livestock heavy, the quiet dream Your inheritance lies on the other side With the Reubenites proudly pride Thank you.
